section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample of 215 self-identified heterosexual women recruited primarily in the Ottawa region of Canada via community posters, online advertisements, and snowball sampling. The sample had a mean age of 38.08 years (SD=13.80), mean BMI of 26.11 (SD=6.18), was predominantly Caucasian (88.5%), and highly educated (88% postsecondary). No body appreciation measure (BAS/BAS-2) or correlation between body appreciation and BMI is reported in this section.
